fundamental.text: Raw sugar is only 2.16¢/lb above hydrous-ethanol parity in Brazil: mills still favour sugar, but No. 11 is near the level where Centre-South cane swings to ethanol, which has tended to act as a floor. Sugar in BRL at R$2,285/t (57th pct of 5 yrs). Raws recovered most of last week's break into the US holiday on renewed speculative buying, which says the fund long was not flushed out and is still the swing factor in both directions. Desk read: The real's jump on the Trabuco appointment is the dominant input: a stronger real raises the dollar break-even for Centre-South mills and discourages new forward hedges, a modest prop for prices while the Brazilian intercrop season starts. Crude's intraday reversal trims the ethanol-parity support a little.
